mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it connected nerve signals and blood supply to the same muscles, tying earlier topics together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eye and ears was clear but mostly predictable placement, with little to decide once I chose to prepare the head.

surprise.text: The final model showed that the same muscle needs both nerve signals and materials carried by blood; that connection made the separate systems feel less separate.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The placements had clear matching locations, although the last two were the only offered combinations rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the systems work together in a new situation; the final assembly tied them together, though some placements were predictable.
